summary: Huize Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release with unaudited first-half 2026 results; no transactional or special-situation event is disclosed. Gross written premiums rose 29.8% year-over-year to RMB4,196.4 million, first-year premiums grew 48.7% to RMB2,763.0 million, total revenue increased 5.8% to RMB719.8 million, and GAAP net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB25.3 million. Cash stood at RMB241.4 million (US$35.6 million). No price, stake, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock appears; this is a routine earnings filing, not a deal.
